id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b25: "It's my proud recipe! Don't forget to take notes! The main dish is Puerto Valor's traditional hearty acqua pazza!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b31: "Mop up the leftover sauce on your plate with fluffy white Champs Sauvages wheat bread! Forget your manners!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b3d: "Dessert is the usual: finest cake direct from Gondolia and fresh tropical fruit from Lonalulu!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2be3: "Well, welcome, cute traveler. This is Medal Academy's dormitory, where students live their daily lives.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bf3: "Normally boys can't stay, but for a tired traveler it's another matter. Well? Want to stay at the Academy dorm?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c0c: "Heh heh, rest your body well, cute traveler...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c15: "Heh heh, you slept soundly. Come back anytime.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c21: "My, my, so bashful. What a cute traveler.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c2f: "A boy freely walking around this school... You're the first.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c3a: "Normally strangers like you are turned away at the school gate by the janitor, Mr. Gilliam.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c49: "The Headmaster seems to welcome you too. Who are you, really? You don't seem like an ordinary traveler.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c7a: "Honestly... the Headmaster is eccentric, I say! Letting such a perfectly ordinary boy wander the academy!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c88: "Medal Academy is the world's finest girls' school! A gentleman associated with future lovely ladies needs proper dignity, I say!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cc5: "Medal Academy is the world's finest girls' school! A gentleman associated with future lovely ladies needs proper dignity, I say!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c99: "Even if the Headmaster approves, I, the student guidance teacher, have not approved you, I say! Mind your conduct!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cb8: "Since you came to this academy I held my tongue and watched, but I've reached my limit, I say!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cd6: "...And yet you are so ordinary, so ordinary, oh so ordinary!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cdd: "To be a gentleman worthy of this academy, become so charming that I, your guidance teacher, want to kiss you!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ced: "When you believe your charm can meet my critical eye, come back here! Understood, I say?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d03: "...Oh, what a coward! Charm always shines if you polish it! And you give up!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d10: "Listen, traveler! Without challenge there's no growth! You can't move forward looking back, I say!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d29: "...Hmm! A fine answer! To improve your charm, training and polishing yourself comes first, I say.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d38: "But that alone is still green! Only when you think about coordination do you become a truly charming gentleman.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2da9: "But that alone is still green! Only when you think about coordination do you become a truly charming gentleman.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d45: "Change your gear and accessories and your charm changes greatly, I say. Choose the best equipment for you!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2db6: "Change your gear and accessories and your charm changes greatly, I say. Choose the best equipment for you!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d56: "Now then, traveler, do your best, I say! Become the most charming gentleman and return to me!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dc7: "Now then, traveler, do your best, I say! Become the most charming gentleman and return to me!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d75: "Oh, traveler, you're back, I say. Well? Have you become a charming gentleman who meets my critical eye?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d82: "...Hmm! Then at once I'll judge how much your charm has grown!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2df2: "...Hmm! Then at once I'll judge how much your charm has grown!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d92: "...Not at all! Ordinary, ordinary, too ordinary! Far from a charming gentleman!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d9e: "To improve your charm, training and polishing yourself comes first!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2de4: "Oh, traveler, you're back, I say. Well? Have you become a charming gentleman who meets my critical eye?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e02: "...Hmmm~ splendid, I say! What a charming gentleman! Traveler, you did very well.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e0e: "Now, to praise your effort, a hot kiss from your teacher...!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e17: "...I'm joking, I say! I prefer older men. Take this and forgo the kiss, I say.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e28: "Hmm! I got carried away looking! If I were ten years younger, a kiss so hot it'd make you dizzy...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e34: "Just kidding, I say! I prefer older men! Sorry for getting your hopes up, ho ho ho~!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e59: "Forty years have passed since I began work at Medal Academy. As a teacher I've seen off countless graduating students.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e89: "Forty years have passed since I began work at Medal Academy. As a teacher I've seen off countless graduating students.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e68: "I thought I'd be active forever, but I have aged too. The day I leave this school is near.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e99: "Among them there is one student I can't stop worrying about.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ea2: "She was a bit of a tomboy, mischievous and a handful.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eac: "But simply by being there she made everyone at the academy smile. She was charming, cheerful, and popular with all.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ebc: "But one winter just before graduation, she suddenly left, leaving only a note saying 'withdrawal request'.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ecf: "Thirty years since then... I have aged too. The day I leave this school is near.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2edc: "As my last task as a teacher, I want to hand her this diploma I couldn't give her.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eec: "Traveler, please. Find this student somewhere in the world and give her the diploma?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f03: "...Sorry for the unreasonable request. It was long, long ago. Doing this has no meaning.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f1d: "Thank you! When she left Medal Academy, judging by the address on the letter she sent...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f2c: "She seems to have sent the letter from a kingdom called Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f81: "She seems to have sent the letter from a kingdom called Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f36: "If you go there, someone who knows what became of her must be there. Please ask the people of the kingdom.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f8b: "If you go there, someone who knows what became of her must be there. Please ask the people of the kingdom.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f45: "...Her name is Lilian. Well then, traveler, please. Hand her the diploma.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f9a: "...Her name is Lilian. Well then, traveler, please. Hand her the diploma.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f67: "I can't stop worrying about the girl who left right before graduation...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f73: "When she left Medal Academy, judging by the address on the letter she sent...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fbb: "Oh, traveler, you're back. Did you hand the diploma to Lilian, the student who left?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fc8: {var:1} told Ms. Milligan that Lilian had died and the diploma went to her granddaughter Lily.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fd6: "...I see. It seems I was a little late.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fdc: "...Then the people of Champs Sauvages scattered across the world and were forced into hard lives in unfamiliar lands.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fee: "Lilian was a very strong girl. Even on an unwanted path, she loved her family and lived with all her might...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ffd: "Traveler, thank you for your trouble. Thank you so much for granting this old woman's last wish.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|300c: "It's a modest thanks, but please take this.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3019: "I was about to retire as a teacher, but if Lilian's granddaughter enrolls, I can't say that anymore.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3027: "...Lily, was it? She must be a mischievous girl just like Lilian.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|303e:
I look forward to
Lily's enrollment
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|305b: "...Big brother, you can see me? Wow! Amazing!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3090: "...Big brother, you can see me? Wow! Amazing!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3060: "I'm Rose. I died on my tenth birthday. I'm what you call... a ghost.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3096: "I'm Rose. I died on my tenth birthday. I'm what you call... a ghost.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|306a: "Oh, don't be scared! I'm not the kind of bad ghost who curses people!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|309f: "Oh, don't be scared! I'm not the kind of bad ghost who curses people!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3075: "I want to pass on soon too, but I have unfinished business and can't pass on easily.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30aa: "There's a wish I really want granted, so I can't leave this school... I want to pass on soon too.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30b7: "...Hey, traveler big brother. You can see me and you came here, so surely it's the will of the gods.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30c2: "Since I can't leave, please grant my last wish for me. Hey... please?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30d5: "...I see, you're busy, big brother. It may be decades, but I'll wait for someone who can see me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30ee: "Thank you! Traveler big brother! ...My wish is just one thing.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30f6: "To get the legendary treasure left by Nulsuke, the best medal lover who shines brightest in Medal Academy history!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3106: "They say that treasure's glow is like gold rolling in waves, captivating all who see it.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3153: "They say that treasure's glow is like gold rolling in waves, captivating all who see it.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3114: "They say that treasure's glow captivates all who see it, like gold.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3161: "They say that treasure's glow captivates all who see it, like gold.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3122: "One theory says it was buried in Nulsuke's grave somewhere in Champs Sauvages!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|316e: "One theory says it was buried in Nulsuke's grave somewhere in Champs Sauvages!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|312e: "Please, big brother! Find the legendary treasure Nulsuke left and bring it to me!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|317b: "Please, big brother! Find the legendary treasure Nulsuke left and bring it to me!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3144: "My wish is just one thing. To get the legendary treasure left by Nulsuke, the greatest medal lover ever.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3196: "Oh! Welcome back, big brother! Did you find Nulsuke's grave? ...Was the legendary treasure buried there?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31a0:
{var:1} told Rose that the
legendary treasure was the beautiful
landscape of Champs Sauvages.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31ac: "Champs Sauvages' golden wheat fields... Nulsuke loved his hometown more than any lavish treasure or majestic scenery, huh.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31bc: "Champs Sauvages' beautiful landscape... Nulsuke loved his hometown more than any lavish treasure or majestic scenery, huh.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31cc: "Big brother, thank you for granting my last wish. ...As thanks, take this!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31d6: "I'll hurry to Heaven and look down from the sky at Champs Sauvages' golden shining wheat fields.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31e5: "I'll hurry to Heaven and look down from the sky at Champs Sauvages' beautiful landscape.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31f3: "Well, bye-bye, big brother! Play with me again someday!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31fb:
Ah, I want to
pass on soon...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|321a: "Pikii, hey, hey, did you know? This house was a villa of an eccentric king who loved tiny medals.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3226: "He lived in secluded places like this to understand the feelings of tiny medals hiding in shadows, they say.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3234: "People absorbed in something think thoughts we can't understand.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3298: "Sob... sob... Oh, it's the end of the world... I smell terrible right now...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32a1: "I ran out of my favorite fragrant perfume and can't hide the rotten smell... This is as good as dead...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3327: "I ran out of my favorite fragrant perfume and can't hide the rotten smell... This is as good as dead...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ae: "...Traveler, please, I beg you with courage. Could you fetch the Fragrant perfume from my family home?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32c4: "Ugh... without Fragrant perfume I can't live. What should I do now...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32db: "...Thank you, traveler! In truth, my father Smith makes Fragrant perfume.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32e7: "Normally he sends it every month without fail, but nothing has come for two months.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32f3: "My family lives in the Wasteland Labyrinth underground, west of Hotto Steppe.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3335: "My family lives in the Wasteland Labyrinth underground, west of Hotto Steppe.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32fe: "Lately fierce monsters appear around there. I hope that has nothing to do with the perfume not arriving...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3340: "Lately fierce monsters appear around there. I hope that has nothing to do with the perfume not arriving...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|330e: "Well then, traveler, please. Get the Fragrant perfume from my father, Smith, in the Wasteland Labyrinth.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3350: "Well then, traveler, please. Get the Fragrant perfume from my father, Smith, in the Wasteland Labyrinth.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3364: "...Traveler, you're back. Did you bring my Fragrant perfume...?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3371: "...Oh! Is it impossible after all! Without Fragrant perfume I can't live!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3387: "Ah! This lovely scent is surely my father's Fragrant perfume!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|338f: "Thank you, traveler! Now I can live!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3397: "This is my token of thanks! Please accept it!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33a7: "Ah, Fragrant perfume really is the best scent in the world.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33af: "...Huh? What are the ingredients? Ohoho... my father told me not to tell humans.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33ba: "Our sensibilities differ a little from yours.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33e0: "Y-you're the Champion! It's me! Delgins, the one the orphanage kids called the phantom fighter!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33ec: "Why am I in a place like this? Well... after you called me a phantom fighter, I got carried away...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33fc: "While testing my limit of how long I could go unnoticed, I ended up inside Medal Academy.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3409: "But I got too carried away and was found... mistaken for a thief and put in this storeroom.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3417: "By the way... did you need something from someone as pathetic as me?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3420: "...What? You want the secret of hide-and-seek? It's presumptuous for me, who got found like this, to speak of it.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|342d: "But if I may say so, the secret of hide-and-seek is a pure heart and having fun with friends.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|343a: "Time playing with friends is a priceless treasure. Be grateful to friends who seek you, and play hide-and-seek to the fullest.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|346b: "Time playing with friends is a priceless treasure. Be grateful to friends who seek you, and play hide-and-seek to the fullest.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|349b: "Time playing with friends is a priceless treasure. Be grateful to friends who seek you, and play hide-and-seek to the fullest.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3452: "It's presumptuous for me, who got carried away and was found, to speak of hide-and-seek's secret...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3482: "It's presumptuous for me, who got carried away and was found, to speak of hide-and-seek's secret...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|345e: "But if I may say so, the secret of hide-and-seek is a pure heart and having fun with friends.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|348f: "But if I may say so, the secret of hide-and-seek is a pure heart and having fun with friends.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34bb: "Sorry... please leave me alone. Someone like me belongs alone in a cramped place like this.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34d7: "Sorry... please leave me alone. Someone like me belongs alone in a cramped place like this.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34c6: "Ah... I envy Vince. The glory of a fighter in the arena is a distant dream for me...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34e2: "Ah... I envy Vince. The glory of a fighter in the arena is a distant dream for me...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34fa: "What, you're looking for a fighter named Delgins? That's me... what business could you have?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3506: "...What! An orphanage boy wants the autograph of me, the phantom fighter?!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3513: "No, no, that can't be! I've never once been called a phantom fighter!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|351f: "At the Masked Tournament I'm so low-profile no one notices me, so I couldn't pair up. I didn't even pass the lottery.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|352f: "Even when I stand beside my opponent and call out, they don't notice... oh dear.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3539: "...But I don't want to crush a child's dream. All right... if my autograph will do, please take it.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|354a: "Honestly, I was happy. That a child asked for my autograph, even if mostly a misunderstanding.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3557: "Now, that boy is waiting, right? It feels like a deception, but please deliver my autograph.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3569: "For the boy who got my autograph, maybe I should remain the phantom fighter forever.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3573: "If he learned my true self, he'd surely be disillusioned. Telling him the truth would be cruel.

tm.「自慢のレシピだ！ メモするのを忘れなさんな！\n メインディッシュは ソルティ: "It's my proud recipe! Don't forget to take notes! The main dish is Puerto Valor's traditional hearty acqua pazza!
tm.「バンデルフォン小麦の ふわふわ白パンで\n お皿に残った ソースをペロリ！\n: "Mop up the leftover sauce on your plate with fluffy white Champs Sauvages wheat bread! Forget your manners!
tm.「デザートは おなじみ\n ダーハルーネ直送 極上ケーキと\n ナギムナーの 新: "Dessert is the usual: finest cake direct from Gondolia and fresh tropical fruit from Lonalulu!
tm.「あら いらっしゃい かわいい旅人さん。\n ここは メダル女学園の学生寮。\n: "Well, welcome, cute traveler. This is Medal Academy's dormitory, where students live their daily lives.
tm.「本当だったら 男の子は 泊められないけれど\n 疲れた旅人さんなら お話は別よ: "Normally boys can't stay, but for a tired traveler it's another matter. Well? Want to stay at the Academy dorm?
tm.「ふふふ ゆっくり 身体を休めてね\n かわいい旅人さん……。: "Heh heh, rest your body well, cute traveler...
tm.「ふふふ ぐっすり 眠っていたわね。\n また いつでも いらっしゃい。: "Heh heh, you slept soundly. Come back anytime.
tm.「あら あら はずかしがっちゃって\n かわいい旅人さんね。: "My, my, so bashful. What a cute traveler.
tm.「この学校を自由に歩きまわる 男の子なんて\n あなたが はじめてだわ。: "A boy freely walking around this school... You're the first.
tm.「普段だったら 見知らぬ男の人は\n 校門の前で 用務員のギリアムさんが\n 追: "Normally strangers like you are turned away at the school gate by the janitor, Mr. Gilliam.
tm.「校長先生にも 歓迎されたようだし\n あなたは いったい 何者なの？\n ただ: "The Headmaster seems to welcome you too. Who are you, really? You don't seem like an ordinary traveler.
tm.「まったく……校長先生も 物好きざます！\n こーんな ごくごく ふつうの少年に: "Honestly... the Headmaster is eccentric, I say! Letting such a perfectly ordinary boy wander the academy!
tm.「メダル女学園は 世界一の名門女子校！\n 未来の ステキなレディに 関わる紳士: "Medal Academy is the world's finest girls' school! A gentleman associated with future lovely ladies needs proper dignity, I say!
tm.「校長先生が認めても 生徒指導たるわたくしは\n あなたを認めたわけでは ないざ: "Even if the Headmaster approves, I, the student guidance teacher, have not approved you, I say! Mind your conduct!
tm.「あなたが この学園にいらしてから\n 何も言わずに 様子を見ていたけれど\n: "Since you came to this academy I held my tongue and watched, but I've reached my limit, I say!
tm.「……それなのに あなたときたら\n ごくごく ふつう ああ ふつうっ！: "...And yet you are so ordinary, so ordinary, oh so ordinary!
tm.「この学園に ふさわしい紳士になりたければ\n 生徒指導のわたくしが キッスした: "To be a gentleman worthy of this academy, become so charming that I, your guidance teacher, want to kiss you!
tm.「ご自分のみりょくが わたくしの\n おメガネに かなうと お思いになったなら\: "When you believe your charm can meet my critical eye, come back here! Understood, I say?
tm.「……まあ なんて意気地なしなんざましょ！\n みりょくとは 磨けば 必ず光るも: "...Oh, what a coward! Charm always shines if you polish it! And you give up!
tm.「いいざますか 旅人さん！\n 何事も 挑戦なくして 成長なし！\n 後ろむきじ: "Listen, traveler! Without challenge there's no growth! You can't move forward looking back, I say!
tm.「……んん！ いい お返事ざます！\n みりょくを向上させるには\n 修行を積み: "...Hmm! A fine answer! To improve your charm, training and polishing yourself comes first, I say.
tm.「しかし それだけでは まだまだアマちゃん！\n コーディネートを 考えるように: "But that alone is still green! Only when you think about coordination do you become a truly charming gentleman.
tm.「身につける武具や アクセサリーが変われば\n みりょくも 大きく変わるざます。: "Change your gear and accessories and your charm changes greatly, I say. Choose the best equipment for you!
tm.「それじゃあ 旅人さん がんばるざますよ！\n 誰よりも 魅力的な紳士となって\: "Now then, traveler, do your best, I say! Become the most charming gentleman and return to me!
tm.「おや 旅人さん 戻ってきたざますね。\n どうざます？ わたくしの おメガネに: "Oh, traveler, you're back, I say. Well? Have you become a charming gentleman who meets my critical eye?
tm.「……んん！ それじゃあ さっそく\n 成長した あなたの みりょくのほどを\n: "...Hmm! Then at once I'll judge how much your charm has grown!
tm.「……ぜんっぜん ダメざます！\n ふつうも ふつう ふつうすぎざます！\n 魅: "...Not at all! Ordinary, ordinary, too ordinary! Far from a charming gentleman!
tm.「みりょくを向上させるには\n 修行を積み 自分を磨くことが第一ざます！: "To improve your charm, training and polishing yourself comes first!
tm.「おや 旅人さん 戻ってきたざますね。\n どうざます？ わたくしのおメガネにか: "Oh, traveler, you're back, I say. Well? Have you become a charming gentleman who meets my critical eye?
tm.「……んん～ すんばらしいざます！\n なんと 魅力的な紳士ざましょ！\n 旅人: "...Hmmm~ splendid, I say! What a charming gentleman! Traveler, you did very well.
tm.「では さっそく その努力をたたえて\n 先生の あつ～いキッスを……！: "Now, to praise your effort, a hot kiss from your teacher...!
tm.「……というのは 冗談ざます！\n 先生は 年上が好みなんざます。\n これをあ: "...I'm joking, I say! I prefer older men. Take this and forgo the kiss, I say.
tm.「んん！ ついつい 見とれていたざます！\n わたくしが １０歳 若かったら\n: "Hmm! I got carried away looking! If I were ten years younger, a kiss so hot it'd make you dizzy...
tm.「なーんちゃって 冗談ざますよ！\n わたくし 年上が好みなんざます！\n 期待: "Just kidding, I say! I prefer older men! Sorry for getting your hopes up, ho ho ho~!
tm.「メダル女学園に勤務して はや４０年。\n 数えきれない生徒の巣立ちを\n 教師: "Forty years have passed since I began work at Medal Academy. As a teacher I've seen off countless graduating students.
tm.「いつまでも 現役と思っていましたが\n 私も トシを取りました。\n この学校: "I thought I'd be active forever, but I have aged too. The day I leave this school is near.
tm.「その中に たったひとりだけ\n 気がかりで 仕方のない生徒がいるのです。: "Among them there is one student I can't stop worrying about.
tm.「彼女は すこしばかり おてんばで\n いたずら好きな 手のかかる子でした。: "She was a bit of a tomboy, mischievous and a handful.
tm.「けれど 彼女が そこにいるだけで\n 学園の皆が 笑顔になるような\n 魅力的: "But simply by being there she made everyone at the academy smile. She was charming, cheerful, and popular with all.
tm.「しかし 卒業式を間近にひかえた年の冬でした。\n 退学願い とだけ書かれた手紙: "But one winter just before graduation, she suddenly left, leaving only a note saying 'withdrawal request'.
tm.「それから ３０年……\n 私も トシを取りました。\n この学校を去る日も 近: "Thirty years since then... I have aged too. The day I leave this school is near.
tm.「教師である 私の最後の仕事として\n この 渡せなかった卒業証書を\n 彼女に: "As my last task as a teacher, I want to hand her this diploma I couldn't give her.
tm.「旅人さん どうか お願いです。\n 世界のどこかにいる この生徒を見つけだし\: "Traveler, please. Find this student somewhere in the world and give her the diploma?
tm.「……ムリを言って ごめんなさい。\n もう 遠い 遠い昔のことです。\n こん: "...Sorry for the unreasonable request. It was long, long ago. Doing this has no meaning.
tm.「ありがとうございます！\n 彼女が メダル女学園を退学した時\n 送られてきた: "Thank you! When she left Medal Academy, judging by the address on the letter she sent...
tm.「彼女は クレイモランという王国から\n 手紙を出したようなのです。: "She seems to have sent the letter from a kingdom called Sniflheim.
tm.「その王国に行けば 彼女の消息を知る者が\n きっと いるはずです。\n 王国の: "If you go there, someone who knows what became of her must be there. Please ask the people of the kingdom.
tm.「……彼女の名前は リリアンです。\n それでは 旅人さん お願いしますね。\n: "...Her name is Lilian. Well then, traveler, please. Hand her the diploma.
tm.「卒業式を間近に 退学してしまった女生徒が\n 私は 気がかりでなりません……。: "I can't stop worrying about the girl who left right before graduation...
tm.「彼女が メダル女学園を退学した時\n 送られてきた 手紙の住所を見るに……: "When she left Medal Academy, judging by the address on the letter she sent...
tm.「あら 旅人さん 戻られましたか。\n 退学した生徒 リリアンに\n 卒業証書を: "Oh, traveler, you're back. Did you hand the diploma to Lilian, the student who left?
tm.{var:1}は ミリガン先生に\nリリアンは すでに亡くなっており\n孫のリリ: {var:1} told Ms. Milligan that Lilian had died and the diploma went to her granddaughter Lily.
tm.「……そうですか。\n すこし……遅かったようですね。: "...I see. It seems I was a little late.
tm.「……あの当時 バンデルフォン王国の人々は\n 世界中へ ちりぢりになり 慣れぬ: "...Then the people of Champs Sauvages scattered across the world and were forced into hard lives in unfamiliar lands.
tm.「リリアンは とても 強い子ね。\n 望まぬ道であったとしても 家族を愛し\n: "Lilian was a very strong girl. Even on an unwanted path, she loved her family and lived with all her might...
tm.「旅人さん ご苦労をかけましたね。\n この年寄りの 最後の願いをかなえてくれて: "Traveler, thank you for your trouble. Thank you so much for granting this old woman's last wish.
tm.「お礼としては ささやかなものですが\n これを受け取ってくださいな。: "It's a modest thanks, but please take this.
tm.「もうすぐ 教師は引退しようと思っていたけど\n リリアンの孫が 入学するのなら: "I was about to retire as a teacher, but if Lilian's granddaughter enrolls, I can't say that anymore.
tm.「……リリーと言ったかしら？\n リリアンに よく 似た\n おてんば娘に ちが: "...Lily, was it? She must be a mischievous girl just like Lilian.
tm.リリーの入学が\n楽しみですわ:
I look forward to
Lily's enrollment
tm.「……おにいちゃん あたしが見えるの？\n すごい！ すごいわ！: "...Big brother, you can see me? Wow! Amazing!
tm.「あたしは ローズ。\n １０歳の誕生日に 死んじゃったんだ。\n いわゆる……: "I'm Rose. I died on my tenth birthday. I'm what you call... a ghost.
tm.「あっ！ こわがらなくても 大丈夫だよ！\n あたしは 人を呪ったりするような\: "Oh, don't be scared! I'm not the kind of bad ghost who curses people!
tm.「あたしだって 早く 成仏したいけど\n 心残りなことが あって\n なかなか: "I want to pass on soon too, but I have unfinished business and can't pass on easily.
tm.「ただ どうしても かなえたい願いがあって\n この学校を離れられないんだ……。: "There's a wish I really want granted, so I can't leave this school... I want to pass on soon too.
tm.「……ねえ 旅人のおにいちゃん。\n あたしが見える あなたが ここに来たのは\: "...Hey, traveler big brother. You can see me and you came here, so surely it's the will of the gods.
tm.「ここを離れられない あたしの代わりに\n あたしの 最後の願いをかなえてほしい: "Since I can't leave, please grant my last wish for me. Hey... please?
tm.「……そっか おにいちゃんも 忙しいもんね。\n 何十年後になるか わからないけ: "...I see, you're busy, big brother. It may be decades, but I'll wait for someone who can see me.
tm.「ありがとう！ 旅人のおにいちゃん！\n ……あたしの願いは たった ひとつだけ: "Thank you! Traveler big brother! ...My wish is just one thing.
tm.「メダル女学園の歴史に さんぜんと かがやく\n 最高のメダル愛好家 ヌルスケが: "To get the legendary treasure left by Nulsuke, the best medal lover who shines brightest in Medal Academy history!
tm.「その伝説の秘宝の かがやきは\n 波のように押しよせる 黄金のようで\n 見る: "They say that treasure's glow is like gold rolling in waves, captivating all who see it.
tm.「その伝説の秘宝の かがやきは\n まるで 黄金のように\n 見る者の心を魅了す: "They say that treasure's glow captivates all who see it, like gold.
tm.「一説によると バンデルフォン地方の\n どこかに建てられた ヌルスケのお墓に\: "One theory says it was buried in Nulsuke's grave somewhere in Champs Sauvages!
tm.「お願い おにいちゃん！\n ヌルスケが残した 伝説の秘宝を見つけて\n あたし: "Please, big brother! Find the legendary treasure Nulsuke left and bring it to me!
tm.「あたしの願いは たったひとつだけ。\n 史上最高のメダル愛好家 ヌルスケが残し: "My wish is just one thing. To get the legendary treasure left by Nulsuke, the greatest medal lover ever.
tm.「あっ！ おかえり おにいちゃん！\n ヌルスケのお墓 見つかった？\n ……伝: "Oh! Welcome back, big brother! Did you find Nulsuke's grave? ...Was the legendary treasure buried there?

{var:1} told Rose that the
legendary treasure was the beautiful
landscape of Champs Sauvages.
tm.「バンデルフォンの 金色の小麦畑か……。\n ヌルスケは どんなに 豪華な宝や\: "Champs Sauvages' golden wheat fields... Nulsuke loved his hometown more than any lavish treasure or majestic scenery, huh.
tm.「バンデルフォンの 美しい風景か……。\n ヌルスケは どんなに 豪華な宝や\n: "Champs Sauvages' beautiful landscape... Nulsuke loved his hometown more than any lavish treasure or majestic scenery, huh.
tm.「おにいちゃん あたしの最後の願いを\n かなえてくれて どうも ありがとう。\: "Big brother, thank you for granting my last wish. ...As thanks, take this!

tm.「あたし 急いで 天国に行って\n お空の上から バンデルフォン地方の\n 美し: "I'll hurry to Heaven and look down from the sky at Champs Sauvages' beautiful landscape.
tm.「それじゃあ バイバイ おにいちゃん！\n また いつか あたしと遊んでね！: "Well, bye-bye, big brother! Play with me again someday!

Ah, I want to
pass on soon...
tm.「ピキっ ねえねえ 知ってる？\n この家はね ちいさなメダルが大好きな\n 変: "Pikii, hey, hey, did you know? This house was a villa of an eccentric king who loved tiny medals.
tm.「こういう 人目につかない場所に住んで\n 物陰にひそむ ちいさなメダルの気持ち: "He lived in secluded places like this to understand the feelings of tiny medals hiding in shadows, they say.
tm.「何かに 夢中になってる人って\n アタシたちには 理解できないような\n 突拍: "People absorbed in something think thoughts we can't understand.
tm.「しくしく……しくしく……。\n ああ この世の終わりだわ……。\n 今のわたく: "Sob... sob... Oh, it's the end of the world... I smell terrible right now...
tm.「愛用の かぐわしい香水を切らしてしまって\n くさったニオイを隠せないのです…: "I ran out of my favorite fragrant perfume and can't hide the rotten smell... This is as good as dead...
tm.「……旅の方 勇気を出して お願いします。\n かぐわしい香水を わたくしの実家: "...Traveler, please, I beg you with courage. Could you fetch the Fragrant perfume from my family home?
tm.「うう……かぐわしい香水が なければ\n わたくしは 生きていけないわ。\n い: "Ugh... without Fragrant perfume I can't live. What should I do now...
tm.「……ありがとうございます 旅の方！\n じつは わたくしの父 スミスは\n か: "...Thank you, traveler! In truth, my father Smith makes Fragrant perfume.
tm.「いつもなら 毎月 かかさず\n かぐわしい香水を送ってくださるのに\n もう: "Normally he sends it every month without fail, but nothing has come for two months.
tm.「わたくしの家族は ホムスビ山地の西にある\n 荒野の地下迷宮で暮らしております: "My family lives in the Wasteland Labyrinth underground, west of Hotto Steppe.
tm.「近頃 あの辺には 凶悪な魔物が\n 出現するようですし 香水が届かないことと\: "Lately fierce monsters appear around there. I hope that has nothing to do with the perfume not arriving...
tm.「それでは 旅の方 よろしくお願いします。\n 荒野の地下迷宮に住む 父 スミス: "Well then, traveler, please. Get the Fragrant perfume from my father, Smith, in the Wasteland Labyrinth.
tm.「……旅の方 お戻りになられたのね。\n それじゃ わたくしの かぐわしい香水を: "...Traveler, you're back. Did you bring my Fragrant perfume...?
tm.「……ああ！ やはり ムリなのかしら！\n かぐわしい香水が なければ\n わた: "...Oh! Is it impossible after all! Without Fragrant perfume I can't live!
tm.「ああ！ この ステキな香りは\n まさしく 父の作った かぐわしい香水！: "Ah! This lovely scent is surely my father's Fragrant perfume!
tm.「ありがとうございます 旅人さん！\n これで わたくし 生きていけますわ！: "Thank you, traveler! Now I can live!
tm.「これは わたくしからの\n 感謝のしるしですわ！\n 受け取ってくださいませ！: "This is my token of thanks! Please accept it!
tm.「はあ やはり かぐわしい香水は\n 世界で いちばん いい香りですわ。: "Ah, Fragrant perfume really is the best scent in the world.
tm.「……え？ 材料は何かって？\n オホホ……人間さんには\n 言わないようにと: "...Huh? What are the ingredients? Ohoho... my father told me not to tell humans.
tm.「わたくしたちと あなた方の感性は\n すこし ちがいますからね。: "Our sensibilities differ a little from yours.
tm.「あ…あなたは チャンピオン！\n 私です！ 孤児院の子に 幻の闘士と\n 呼ば: "Y-you're the Champion! It's me! Delgins, the one the orphanage kids called the phantom fighter!
tm.「なぜ 私が こんな所にいるのかって？\n それがですね……あなたたちに 幻の闘: "Why am I in a place like this? Well... after you called me a phantom fighter, I got carried away...
tm.「どこまで 気づかれないか\n 自分の限界を 試しているうちに\n メダル女学園: "While testing my limit of how long I could go unnoticed, I ended up inside Medal Academy.
tm.「ですが……さすがに 調子に乗りすぎて\n 見つかってしまい……泥棒に 間違えら: "But I got too carried away and was found... mistaken for a thief and put in this storeroom.
tm.「ところで……\n この あまりにも 情けない私に\n ご用が おありでしたか？: "By the way... did you need something from someone as pathetic as me?
tm.「……え？ かくれんぼの極意を教えてくれ？\n そんなのは こうして 見つけられ: "...What? You want the secret of hide-and-seek? It's presumptuous for me, who got found like this, to speak of it.
tm.「でも そうですね。あえて言わせてもらえるなら\n かくれんぼの極意は 純真な気: "But if I may say so, the secret of hide-and-seek is a pure heart and having fun with friends.
tm.「友達と遊ぶ時間は かけがえのない宝物です。\n 自分を探してくれる友達に 感謝: "Time playing with friends is a priceless treasure. Be grateful to friends who seek you, and play hide-and-seek to the fullest.
tm.「調子に乗って 見つかってしまった 私が\n えらそうに かくれんぼの極意を語る: "It's presumptuous for me, who got carried away and was found, to speak of hide-and-seek's secret...
tm.「あえて言わせてもらえるなら\n かくれんぼの極意は 純真な気持ちで\n とにか: "But if I may say so, the secret of hide-and-seek is a pure heart and having fun with friends.
tm.「すいません……そっとしておいてください。\n 私なんて こういう せまーい場所: "Sorry... please leave me alone. Someone like me belongs alone in a cramped place like this.
tm.「ああ……ハンフリーさんが うらやましい。\n 闘技場の 闘士としての 栄光なん: "Ah... I envy Vince. The glory of a fighter in the arena is a distant dream for me...
tm.「えっ デルギンスという 闘士を探している？\n デルギンスは 私ですが……\n: "What, you're looking for a fighter named Delgins? That's me... what business could you have?
tm.「……ええっ！ 孤児院の男の子が\n 幻の闘士と呼ばれる 私のサインを\n ほし: "...What! An orphanage boy wants the autograph of me, the phantom fighter?!
tm.「いやいや それは ないでしょう！\n だって 私 幻の闘士だなんて\n 一度た: "No, no, that can't be! I've never once been called a phantom fighter!
tm.「なんせ 仮面武闘会では 影が薄いせいで\n 誰からも気づかれず パートナーと組: "At the Masked Tournament I'm so low-profile no one notices me, so I couldn't pair up. I didn't even pass the lottery.
